title: Kuwait atmospheric CDU heat-recovery retrofit: reduce furnace duty with limited network changes
source: Al-Riyami et al., Case Studies in Thermal Engineering 28 (2021) 101030; existing refinery HEN and utility targets only
question: Reduce atmospheric-CDU furnace and cooling duty using the existing three heat-exchanger networks, with the fewest exchanger changes and a 12.5 C minimum approach. What retrofit is justified?

throughput.name: atmospheric CDU feed
throughput.unit: b/d (plant class; exact source rate is not disclosed)

data_note: Published retrofit study of a real Kuwait refinery CDU, not a commissioned performance test. The paper reports the existing 19-exchanger network, key train temperatures and duties, and pinch targets, while withholding the proposed topology in outcome.json. The exact crude rate and assay are not disclosed; 400,000 b/d is only the paper's plant-class description and must not be used as a calibrated mass flow.
suggested_questions: Where is recoverable heat rejected to cooling?
Which exchanger relocation gives the smallest retrofit?
What furnace saving survives the 12.5 C approach constraint?
